Name: Billy Graham
Summary: American evangelist (1918-2018) who led worldwide crusades for over six decades and founded the Billy Graham Evangelistic Association.
Contribution: Through stadium crusades, radio, television, and writing he preached the gospel to more people in person than any evangelist before him, and counselled presidents while keeping evangelism at the centre of his ministry.
Testimony: He consistently pointed hearers to personal faith in Christ and a life of repentance and service.
